crossRefs.note: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they…
Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears…
Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that…
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and…
Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his…
You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
“ ‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’ ”
You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.
“Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.
that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
“ ‘ “My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
“ ‘ “But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them…
For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.
translations.bsb: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
translations.kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth
translations.asv: And now, O Israel, hearken unto the statutes and unto the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, giveth you.
